EXISTING_PAIR_GATE_explicit.statement: If the shared-k selection seals k* = 0, the SCK_4V4_CONFIRM block (28800001..28800128) IS the existing-pair qualification gate, not related evidence: k = 0 is exactly the sealed specialist pair with no role intervention.
EXISTING_PAIR_GATE_explicit.decision: mean Delta_A^base > 0 AND mean Delta_B^base > 0 on that block -> PASS: keep the existing specialists and proceed to the unchanged role stage; otherwise -> FAIL: invoke the frozen candidate procedure (3A + 3B -> D_select -> (A*, B*) -> D_gate -> D_confirm), with no second-best fallback, no extra candidate and no new k.

WHAT_IS_TESTED: the stochastic reliability of the EXISTING specialist-training procedure (the same b3 parent -> 1M-step entity-repair continuation, same budget, same recipe, same environment/genome treatment, different pre-reserved seeds); not a new training algorithm. Candidates are never fresh-from-scratch runs.
